python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
p='/app/main.db'
c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
rows=c.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM inventory ORDER BY id').fetchall()
assert len(rows)==5
assert all(type(i) is int and isinstance(n,str) and type(v) is int for i,n,v in rows)
with open('/app/recovered.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump([{'id':i,'name':n,'value':v} for i,n,v in rows],f,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(open('/app/recovered.json',encoding='utf-8').read())
